function: F-07.1 — Auto-generate a surveillance-event report on trigger condition and transmit it to C2. The report body is machine-assembled (timestamp, geo, sensor context) when monitored conditions are met; the pilot's role is limited to pre-arming: creating triggers and attaching predefined metadata (title, description) before the event fires. Distinct from R05's pilot-authored full-compose function; what is new here is the trigger side, not the transmission.
function_summary: Trigger-based automated surveillance report generation and C2 transmission.
behaviour: Be-07.1.1 — Interleaved, non-modality-locked arm-and-manage behaviour. The pilot creates a trigger, adds title/description fields, sets the monitored parameters, and arms the event; the pilot can also edit and delete already-present triggers. Every sub-step (create, enter title/description, set parameters, arm, edit, delete) is completable by Touch OR Keyboard and switchable mid-task (start on one modality, finish on another), with redundancy per-step rather than per-pathway. Monitoring is the system's internal, non-modal job: it receives and monitors parameters and, once conditions are met, auto-assembles the report (timestamp/geo/sensor + pilot title/description). Dispatch is instant and unattended — no pilot confirmation on trigger-fire — and a post-send notification informs the pilot that a report was sent to C2.
behaviour_summary: Per-step touch/keyboard trigger management with automatic report dispatch.
structure: S-07.1.1.2 — R06 list/detail pattern backed by a single trigger store: trigger-list panel (rows = title + condition summary + armed-state indicator) on the list side, trigger-editor on the detail side. Create/edit/delete triggers via Touch tap/swipe/button OR bezel OSS (interleaved, switchable). Title/description via Touch on-screen keypad OR UCP alphanumeric with a shared field buffer (no modality lock). Parameter-condition via Touch value widget OR rotary/OSS stepping, writing the same condition object. Arm-time validation gate (reused R01/R05 flight-envelope-style gate) as the SOLE gate — a trigger cannot be armed unless condition and metadata are valid. ARM press-and-confirm toggle with persistent armed-state (R03 pattern). Internal monitoring → instant unattended transmit to C2 (reusing R05 transmit plumbing only, not its confirm UI). Dispatch notification via R02/R06 multi-channel alert framework (notification strip + audio ping), output-only, not a confirmation gate.
structure_summary: Multimodal trigger list/editor with arm-gated autonomous C2 dispatch
